baseline: Saved pre-change working-tree bundle, including prior unreleased speed follow-up changes; not the published RC1 binary.
candidate: Uncommitted Python-only CLI/host optimization; version remains 0.3.0-rc.1; no release.
environment: Windows 11; Python 3.14.4; PyInstaller 6.20.0; same ReadyToRun .NET 10/Roslyn 5.0.0 compiler files.
method: Separate sequential Unity runs, baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline; 80 samples per variant per ordinary/exec category; nearest-rank percentiles. Identical current Connector sources, both use external host. Startup ranges have only 2 observations per variant. Update checks disabled equally.
scope: Empty disposable projects, batchmode/nographics, subprocess-to-response time. No reboot, file-cache purge, GUI/background-window, large-project, long-duration, agent-prompt or token-use measurement.
ordinary_gate: Candidate p95 increase <= max(5 percent of baseline, 10 ms). All final gates pass, not a claim that every call improves.
